Class UiKit

java.lang.Object
com.store.inventory.ui.UiKit
public final class UiKit extends Object
Small factory helpers shared by the user-interface classes.

Keeps recurring pieces, such as the small uppercase section labels, in one place so they look the same everywhere.

Author:
Mashal and Umaina

  • Method Details

    • letterSpaced

      public static String letterSpaced(String text)
      Converts text to upper case with a hair space between letters.

      JavaFX CSS has no letter-spacing property, so this is used to give small labels a slightly spaced-out look.

      Parameters:
      text - the text to convert
      Returns:
      the upper-case, letter-spaced text

    • sectionLabel
